question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**The**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the deltaic regions of India.
 
• In the** third filler,** the definite article **'the'** should be used.
 
• The definite article (**the**) is used before **a noun** to indicate that the identity of the **noun** is known to the reader.
 
• The passage talks about major deltas which are specific and particular.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__* The predominantly deltaic eastern coastal plain is an area of deep sedimentation. Over __most__ (1) of its length it is considerably wider __than__ (2) the plain on the western coast. __**The**__ **(3)** major deltas, from south to north, (4) _______ of the Kaveri, the Krishna-Godavari, the Mahanadi, and the Ganges-Brahmaputra rivers. The last of (5)________ is some 190 miles (300 km) wide, but only about one-third of it lies within India.*
